01 / RESEARCH FOCUS

Three connected questions.

How can we make increasingly capable AI systems safe, lawful, and accountable?

01

Can AI follow the law?

Legal alignment of AI agents, with benchmarks that test how agents respond to real legal obligations.

Legal alignment ↗
02

How do we test compliance?

Evaluating how language models interpret policies, reason through constraints, and meet expert-defined standards.

Evaluation & standards ↗
03

Who does language AI serve?

Multilingual language assessment and NLP, extending research across languages, proficiency levels, and communities.

Language & accessibility ↗

03 / A LITTLE CONTEXT

Technical depth.
A human perspective.

I’m Joseph, a researcher working at the intersection of technical AI safety and governance.

My research focuses on the legal alignment of AI agents and the compliance capabilities of language models. At Pivotal Research, I work with Noam Kolt. I also collaborate with Ben Brady and Cullen O’Keefe at the Institute for Law & AI on benchmarking law-following AI.

Before moving to the UK, I worked as a Senior NLP Researcher at National University in the Philippines, managing its Human Language Technology Lab.
